recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on 4, 5, 6, 6X during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at Wall St, where 5 trains run ahead of 4 trains bound for Grand Central-42 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for 4, 5, 6, 6X; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for 4, 5, 6, 6X; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so 5 and 4 slots are offset by at least half a headway at Wall St
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.
